purification_method: washed with 10 wt% HCl and DI water; dried under vacuum at 100 C
activation_method: chemical activation: CC-PNP immersed in 30 wt% KOH solution for 1 h, dried in air, heated at 900 C for 1 h under N2
source_location: main, p.8, Fig. 7a, C30-CC-PNP, filled markers (adsorption), 77 K
notes: Digitized marker centre (adsorption branch); archive: HYC-0091_Fig7a_C30-CC-PNP_77K_adsorption.json. Marker partly covered by other symbols (15 visible px of ~36), centroid biased. Common: ~100 mg sample printed as '~100 mg' (stored 100); degassed 12 h at 200 C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); '99.999% purity' printed in the H2 measurement sentence (read as gas purity); Sievert-type PCTPro-E&E with microdoser (Setaram), free-volume calibration not described. Table 2: Vtot by DFT (note b), Vmicro by DR (note c) on N2 77 K isotherm (Methods also says SPV by Gurvich rule at P/P0=0.99), Vmeso=Vtot-Vmicro; pore size column prints 0.81/2.2 nm (PSD peaks, QSDFT, N2 adsorption branch), first value stored; BET P/P0 range not stated; N at.% by EDS (Table 1: C 79.98, O 9.27, N 10.38, Cl 0.36, Zn 0 at.%).
basis_evidence: Fig. 7a y-axis: 'Excess H2 uptake (wt%)'; Table 4 column: 'Excess H2 uptake (wt%) at 77 K' (basis named, not defined)
measuring_lab_id: Oh group, Gyeongnam National University of Science and Technology

purification_method: washed with 10 wt% HCl and DI water; dried under vacuum at 100 C
activation_method: chemical activation: CC-PNP immersed in 60 wt% KOH solution for 1 h, dried in air, heated at 900 C for 1 h under N2
source_location: main, p.8, Fig. 7a, C60-CC-PNP, filled markers (adsorption), 77 K
notes: Digitized marker centre (adsorption branch); archive: HYC-0091_Fig7a_C60-CC-PNP_77K_adsorption.json. Common: ~100 mg sample printed as '~100 mg' (stored 100); degassed 12 h at 200 C under vacuum (end pressure not stated); '99.999% purity' printed in the H2 measurement sentence (read as gas purity); Sievert-type PCTPro-E&E with microdoser (Setaram), free-volume calibration not described. Table 2: Vtot by DFT (note b), Vmicro by DR (note c) on N2 77 K isotherm (Methods also says SPV by Gurvich rule at P/P0=0.99), Vmeso=Vtot-Vmicro; pore size column prints 0.85/2.2/2.6 nm (PSD peaks, QSDFT, N2 adsorption branch), first value stored; BET P/P0 range not stated; N at.% by EDS (Table 1: C 82.71, O 9.14, N 8.15, Cl 0, Zn 0 at.%).
basis_evidence: Fig. 7a y-axis: 'Excess H2 uptake (wt%)'; Table 4 column: 'Excess H2 uptake (wt%) at 77 K' (basis named, not defined)
